1.title: Lay tie around your collar
1.say: Lay your tie around your collar. Hang the wide end much lower.
placements: your tie → around your collar with both ends hanging down your shirt front (in the video: centered under collar points)
the wide end → hanging much lower than the narrow end down your shirt front (in the video: on the right side of the frame)
watch_for: If both ends hang the same length, the wide end will end too short so start with it much longer.
1.check_yourself: It should look like two ends hanging with one much longer.

2.title: Cross wide end over narrow end
2.say: Hold the narrow end against your shirt. Cross the wide end over the narrow end.
placements: the wide end → over the front of the narrow end in the middle of your shirt just below your collar (in the video: crossing from right side of frame to left forming an X)
watch_for: If you do not see an X, the wide end is probably under so lift it over the top.
2.check_yourself: It should look like an X below your collar.

3.title: Bring wide end up behind collar
3.say: Bring the wide end behind the X. Push it up through the gap behind your collar.
placements: the wide end → behind the X where the ends cross then up through the gap between the tie and your collar (in the video: pulled straight up toward the chin)
watch_for: If the wide end twists going up, smooth it flat or the middle will look twisted.
3.check_yourself: It should look like the wide end pointing straight up.

4.title: Wrap wide end across front
4.say: Bring the wide end across the front. Point it out to the side.
placements: the wide end → across the front of the middle bundle to the side, forming a flat horizontal band (in the video: pulled from right side of frame to left side)
watch_for: If the band looks loose or bunched, spread it flat or the next tuck will jam.
4.check_yourself: It should look like a flat band across the middle.

5.title: Pull wide end down through band
5.say: Lift the wide end up behind your collar. Tuck it down through the front band.
placements: the wide end → up through the gap behind your collar (in the video: lifted straight up behind the knot)
the wide end → down through the flat band across the front, hanging centered over the narrow end (in the video: pulled down through the middle of the band)
watch_for: If the wide end misses the band, it will hang loose so tuck it through the middle of the band.
5.check_yourself: It should look like the wide end hanging through the band.

6.title: Tighten and slide knot up
6.say: Hold the narrow end still. Slide the knot up to your collar.
placements: the knot → slid up to sit centered just under your collar points (in the video: neat triangle filling the collar opening)
the wide end → pulled straight down your shirt front over the narrow end (in the video: hanging centered down the middle)
watch_for: If the knot sits crooked or loose, straighten it and pull gently or it will stay uneven.
6.check_yourself: It should look like a neat triangle under your collar.
